name: M7-6B-14, 2P
headline: Balanced & Bright 2 BDR @ Mangroovy | Free Pool & Beach Access
summary: This contemporary 2 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront community with a 24/7 free pool and beach access and is managed by Xuru Stays

description.Space:
This greatly located 2 bedroom apartment is located in Gouna's only beachfront residence - Mangroovy with a 24/7 free pool and beach access. Mangroovy is closest to the Marina (10 min walk). 

The 2 bedroom apartment comes with an open plan fully equipped kitchen, 2 full ensuite bathrooms with 1 guest bathroom. It also features a living room with a large sofa that can sleep 1 additional guest, not to mention a beautiful large balcony overlooking the pool.  

It also features a 65 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. The apartment is great for couples & families. 

The styling is basic yet relaxing to ensure guests have a wonderful and serene experience. 


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
-Mangroovy residence is uniquely located 800 meters from Abu Tig Marina. Guests will be able to walk 10 minutes and get to it. 
-'Bright Star' supermarket is right in front of the residence towards the Marina.
-Mangroovy is home to the famous 'Noi' beach lounge (located at Mangroovy's beach)
- 'The Smokery', a local favorite is also located 450 meters from the residence.
description.Transit:
Free outdoor parking is available. 
Tuktuks are available to take you anywhere in El Gouna (flat fee 20 EGP).
description.Notes:
Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

Please note that scheduled maintenance works on the external facades and garden terrace areas will take place in Mangroovy Cluster 7 from May 9 until May 13. During this period, technicians may require access to garden and terrace areas to complete the maintenance works. We appreciate your understanding and apologize for any inconvenience caused.

agreement:
• Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

We had a wonderful stay and would highly recommend this apartment. The location in El Gouna is excellent—just a short walk from several beautiful beaches, including Zouni Beach and Smokery Beach, with Moods Beach being our personal favorite.

The apartment was comfortable, well-equipped, and exactly as described. Communication with the host was excellent throughout our stay, and any questions were answered promptly.

There are a few minor maintenance details that could be improved, but they did not affect our overall experience. We truly enjoyed our time here and would happily stay again in the future.
